topic: Switching to a cheaper MVNO cell phone plan vs staying on a big carrier (Nash vs Willow)

scenes.narration: Two identical phones, but one plan costs sixty-five dollars more every month. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding up two identical phones, comic burst banner reads SIXTY FIVE A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nash and Willow both pay a big carrier for unlimited data.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel in a gym of man nash and woman willow near lockers each holding a phone stamped BIG CARRIER, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each phone bill runs ninety dollars every single month right now.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, gym bench with two phone bills side by side each labeled NINETY DOLLARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nash keeps the pricey plan, sure the big network is better.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nash shrugging on a gym treadmill holding a phone, comic banner reads BIG NETWORK, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He never checks his data, using barely six gigabytes monthly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nash at a gym water station staring at a phone data meter stamped SIX GIGABYTES USED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Willow researches MVNOs that rent the same network towers cheaper.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, willow on a gym mat with a laptop comparing plans, a wall chart labeled MVNO SAME TOWERS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She ports her number to a twenty-five dollar prepaid plan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, willow tapping her phone by a gym locker, a plan card stamped TWENTY FIVE DOLLARS PREPAID, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Same coverage, same phone, but she saves sixty-five dollars monthly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, willow flexing in the gym holding her phone, a full signal bars icon labeled SAME COVERAGE, comic banner reads SIXTY FIVE SAVED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: One year later Nash paid over one thousand extra dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked nash on a gym bench holding a stack of bills stamped ONE THOUSAND EXTRA, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Willow banked that seven hundred eighty dollars in savings instead.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, willow dropping cash into a gym duffel bag labeled SAVINGS, a tag reading SEVEN HUNDRED EIGHTY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her call quality never dropped once on the same towers.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, willow smiling on a phone call in the gym, a signal tower icon in the window stamped SAME TOWERS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Check your data use, then switch to a cheaper MVNO. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing a whistle in the gym holding a clipboard reading CHECK YOUR DATA, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
